consequence.statement: Internal routers and services (e.g. ping@internal) no longer show up in access logs, metrics or tracing by default in v3.
consequence.remediation: If you need them, set addInternals for AccessLogs, Metrics and/or Tracing (e.g. Helm values logs.access.addInternals, metrics.addInternals, tracing.addInternals).

assertion.statement: In Traefik v3, access logs, metrics and tracing are disabled by default for internal routers and services such as ping@internal; to turn them back on, set the new addInternals option for each one.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence does not say which access-log, metrics or tracing settings make an environment depend on observability of internal resources. It also covers three separate addInternals options, so a single exposure predicate cannot be pinned without guessing at enablement keys.
